cardDesc: Everything for a gym session — workout gear, shower kit, and the easy-to-forget extras.
intro: Half the battle of a consistent gym habit is just having a packed bag by the door. This checklist covers the workout gear, the shower kit, and the little extras people forget until they're standing at the locker without a padlock. Use it as-is, or open it in Gisti to save your own version, and see the rest of our health and fitness checklists.

items.text: Workout clothes: a moisture-wicking top and shorts or leggings
items.note: Sweat-wicking fabric beats cotton, which stays wet and chafes.

items.text: Proper training shoes for your workout

items.note: Fill it before you leave so you're not queuing at the fountain.

items.text: Small sweat towel for wiping down equipment and yourself
Lifting gloves or wrist straps, if you lift heavy
A resistance band for warm-ups and activation
A pre- or post-workout snack or protein shake
items.note: Protein plus carbs within an hour or two of training supports recovery.

items.text: Shower kit: travel soap or body wash, shampoo, and flip-flops
items.note: Flip-flops keep you off shared shower floors.

items.text: A full change of clean clothes and underwear
A dry bag or plastic bag for sweaty clothes
items.note: Keeps the wet kit from soaking everything else in the bag.

items.text: Membership card or the gym app on your phone
Phone plus a charger or power bank

faq.q: What should I keep in my gym bag?
faq.a: The core kit is workout clothes and shoes, a water bottle, a sweat towel, a padlock, and headphones. If you shower at the gym, add flip-flops, a shower towel, toiletries, deodorant, and a full change of clothes. A resistance band and a post-workout snack round it out.

faq.q: How do I stop my gym bag from smelling?
faq.a: Keep sweaty clothes in a separate dry bag or plastic bag, and empty and air out the whole bag after every session instead of leaving damp kit inside. Tossing in a small pouch of baking soda or a dryer sheet absorbs odor, and washing the bag itself every so often helps.

faq.q: Should I pack my gym bag the night before?
faq.a: Yes — a packed bag by the door removes the biggest excuse to skip a workout. Restock it right after each session: swap in clean clothes, refill snacks, and put your headphones back so it's always ready. Keeping duplicates of small items like a padlock and deodorant in the bag means less to remember.
